subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR require redacted latest-head terminal/log proof for the legacy no-code SQLite upgrade path before merge, or is the current PR-body summary plus tests enough?
rationale: The code path is focused and matches prior direction, but the compatibility-sensitive legacy runtime branch changes how upgraded persisted state is handled and the current proof is still partly summarized.

options.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

options.title: Accept Current Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the source proof, tests, and summarized manual results as enough for this bounded persisted-cache invalidation.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup Elsewhere
options.body: Pause this PR and move the legacy no-code cleanup into doctor or migration-owned code if runtime invalidation is not the intended upgrade policy.

recommendation.title: Require Legacy Upgrade Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted latest-head terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing a pre-code SQLite diagnostic row rederives and Gateway startup proceeds.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc supplied the predecessor PR's explicit-marker direction and is the clearest owner for deciding whether this follow-up satisfies that proof and compatibility bar.
